subject: Next steps: Deployment mode & PoC plan for MedSecure
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Carla Santos <carla.santos@medsecure.com>, Alex Rivera <a.rivera@medsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode recap + PoC ask

Hi Carla / Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and to make the PoC planning concrete. Notes below are condensed from the discussion; please correct anything I missed.

Call recap
- Primary constraint: PHI data locality and integration with your on-prem EHR staging environment.
- Preference expressed: leaning toward Private VPC or on-prem image rather than Hosted API due to audit requirements and firewall policies.
- Procurement / legal: team expects an 8–10 week procurement window but would like to start a technical trial in parallel.
- Success metric for PoC: average 95th percentile inference latency < 250 ms for chat generation at typical enterprise batch sizes (prefiltered traffic), and zero leakage of customer data (isolated KV cache + KMS-managed keys).

Proposed near-term asks
1) Confirm whether you want Redwood to run a Private VPC deployment (we host in a customer-dedicated VPC in our cloud project) or if you require our on-prem bundle/air-gapped image for your data center. Either path is compatible with the technical PoC but differs on timeline and approvals.
2) Identify the technical PoC stakeholders (SRE, Security, Legal, Procurement) and the single trust contact for onboarding.
3) Quick alignment call next week to sign the PoC Statement of Work and lock a two-week technical window.

Attached: PoC_SOW_draft.docx, SOC2_Summary.pdf — these are starter artifacts for your security and procurement teams.

If Private VPC looks right, we can provision an isolated project and run the two-week trial within 7–10 business days after signature. If you require an on-prem image, we’ll need to schedule an install slot (typically 3–4 weeks lead time for air-gapped validations).

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Tues or Wed this week to confirm mode + sign SOW. I can coordinate Marissa and Ben for technical onboarding.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

--
Attachments: PoC_SOW_draft.docx (docx, stub), SOC2_Summary.pdf (pdf, stub)

From: Carla Santos <carla.santos@medsecure.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <a.rivera@medsecure.com>
Cc: Jacob Liu <j.liu@medsecure.com>, Legal Team <legal@medsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 18:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode recap + PoC ask

Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Mode preference: We are inclined to Private VPC hosted by Redwood in a dedicated account/project (not public Hosted API). On-prem would be our fallback if Redwood cannot satisfy the audit/data residency checklist within procurement timelines.

2) Stakeholders: Technical lead for the PoC will be Jacob Liu (SRE). Security review will be handled by our InfoSec lead, Maria Ortega, and Legal/Procurement are copied on this thread (legal@medsecure.com). Alex will be our product owner for the integration.

3) Timing: Procurement timeline remains ~8 weeks, but we can run a limited technical PoC earlier if Redwood can deliver:
   - a private VPC deployment image or a short-lived dedicated project with strict egress controls
   - SOC2 summary and any attestation on encryption in transit & at rest (your SOC2_Summary.pdf is helpful)

Proposed PoC scope (our ask):
- 2-week technical trial in a staging VPC with a subset of anonymized traffic (we will provide a scrubbed dataset and a validation script).
- Deliverables: performance report (latency, token-cost estimates), integration checklist for our SRE, and a security evidence packet for procurement.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency under 250 ms; pass basic SRE smoke tests; documented encryption key handoff (KMS) procedure.

We are open to a kickoff next Wednesday afternoon. Once you confirm the Private VPC option and share an updated PoC_SOW, we’ll route to procurement for an expedited technical review.

-Carla
Director, Infrastructure Operations
MedSecure Health
carla.santos@medsecure.com

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode recap + PoC ask

Carla —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear asks. Short reply with a concrete PoC plan for Private VPC and who will own what.

PoC plan (Private VPC hosted by Redwood) — two-week technical trial - Provisioning window: we can provision an isolated project + network controls in 7 business days after SOW signature. - Onboarding support: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) will run the integration and SRE handoff; Ben Carter (Dedicated Sales) will coordinate capacity and SLA options. - Data handling: we will accept your scrubbed dataset for the trial; all tokens and KV cache will be isolated to the project. KMS keys will be customer-managed (we can integrate with your AWS KMS or provide a dedicated Redwood-managed key with export controls). - Security deliverables: a tailored evidence packet (SOC2 extract, config checklist, network diagram) within 3 business days of provisioning.

Success criteria (finalized with you):
- 95th percentile latency < 250 ms under the defined test load
- Integration smoke tests pass (API auth, KV cache isolation, monitored token accounting)
- Evidence packet accepted by your procurement/security team for next-stage commercial review

Owner roster
- MedSecure: Jacob Liu (SRE) — run validation script & provide scrubbed dataset; Alex Rivera — product owner; Legal/Procurement for contractual review.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (solutions) — lead technical onboarding; Ben Carter (sales infra) — provisioning & capacity; Neha Kapoor — PoC owner and escalation contact.

Next steps
1) We’ll update the PoC_SOW with the Private VPC option and send a DocuSign link for signature (attached: PoC_Checklist.xlsx).
2) Proposed kickoff: Thu, Jun 17, 2027 10:00 AM PT — 30-min call to provision and confirm dataset transfer.
3) If you confirm, Ben will provision the project and we’ll set Marissa’s calendar for the onboarding sessions.

I’ll attach an updated SOW and the checklist as discussed. If procurement needs a different envelope for signatures, let me know and I’ll route accordingly.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
